deviations: Memory layer (Layer 4) is not directly writable by agent — Obsidian has no MCP connection. Context bundles in data/ serve as machine-readable Memory proxy.
Signal layer (Layer 7) has no persistent dashboard. Cross-context signal check runs as on-demand agent session only.

TENURE entry_type is extended per QSM-FAI TEN-06 with implementation-specific values 'policy_apply' (an MCP policy dispatch was applied) and 'ext' (pattern-detection bookkeeping and backfilled rows of unknown original type). Each still satisfies TSS-REC-01 through TSS-REC-05.

TENURE escalation_reason is extended per QSM-FAI ESC-04 with decision-rule trigger identifiers rather than only the §4.2 taxonomy values, so that a rule_conflict escalation records the conflicting rule id inline (ESC-02). Declared here per TSS-CONF-05.

TENURE action_tier (QSM-FAI v1.3.0 §6.1, optional) is populated from 2026-07-25 onward. Entries written before that date carry null, which means 'not recorded' and must NOT be read as tier 0. Records are append-only (TEN-02) and were deliberately not backfilled with inferred tiers.

TENURE action_tier on task_run and policy_apply entries is currently a conservative floor of 3 (Act) rather than a per-task measurement; the task catalog has no action_tier column yet. Some entries logged as Tier 3 are in truth Tier 0 reads.

source.note: Hash is of the CORRECTED source claim, which at fetch time had not yet reached the implementation's main branch. --verify-sources will therefore report divergence until it does. That is the intended behaviour: the check goes green when the two are actually the same, not when someone asserts they are.
